posts.title: “Read by a human” is becoming law
posts.excerpt: California SB 243, New York §1700, Article 5 of the EU AI Act — three jurisdictions, one converging demand: tell people when they're talking to a machine. For most AI companies that's a compliance headache. For practitioners, it's the moat arriving on schedule.
posts.author: The founder's desk

posts.title: The payments problem nobody will solve
posts.excerpt: Stripe lists psychic services as restricted. Square and PayPal follow suit. Apple rejects fortune-telling apps as spam. The entire trade runs on rails that can vanish overnight — and that, precisely, is the opportunity.
posts.author: The founder's desk

posts.title: Flat is fine: the honest bull case
posts.excerpt: Belief in astrology hasn't moved in eight years. The “nones” have plateaued. We put those numbers in our own pitch — because a stable, mainstream, badly-tooled market is a better foundation than a hype curve.
posts.author: The founder's desk

posts.title: The seven-year clock
posts.excerpt: In 2033 the Vatican will mark two thousand years since the Resurrection, and the world's attention will turn — briefly, massively — toward meaning itself. A plan for riding an attention wave you must never co-opt.
posts.author: The founder's desk
